name: Clean Cell US
_note: Added 2026-09-17 for the live Amperage Capital deal (56 units), which had been parked since 2026-09-16 waiting on exactly this: the sign-in domain. orgId is cleancell.us — the domain of robert.bucher@cleancell.us, which is ALSO their website (verified 2026-09-17: resolves, HTTP 200, MX smtp.google.com, so it is a real Workspace domain and passes the work-email gate in api/_lib/public-domains.js). ownerEmail is promoted to owner by scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js once that person has signed in; until then the first sign-in from the domain joins as a member. NAME — THREE SPELLINGS ARE IN PLAY AND ONLY ONE IS THEIRS. cleancell.us calls itself 'Clean Cell US' (og:site_name), so that is what is used here. Active Priorities says 'Cleancell USA'; clearsky-cost-estimator.html carries a battery brand { key: 'cleancells', name: 'Clean Cells' }. That estimator entry is a BRAND in a dropdown, not a tenant, and was deliberately left alone — confirm with Robert whether it is the same company before reconciling it, because renaming a brand key silently rewrites saved estimates. RECEIVER VS ORIGINATOR. receivesFullBom is false because Clean Cell is the MIRROR of FENECON: Fenecon is an OEM that RECEIVES quote requests (true), Clean Cell is an originator that SENDS an opportunity out. Be careful reading that as a marker — false is also the default for every tenant, so this field does not positively say 'originator'. There is no originator flag on a tenant, and inventing one here would be silently dropped: plan() in scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js copies a fixed key list, so an unknown key in this file never reaches Firestore. Originator identity is recorded PER DEAL by omega-originator.js as originatorOrgId, not on the org. requiredTools pins the financing marketplace to their dashboard (omega-tools.js honours requiredTools) because the finance portal's existing submit path IS this deal's route to Amperage. It is about pinning, not access — 'financing' is tier:ALL, so a trial already reaches it; drop this line if they should be able to remove the tile. HOSTNAME DOES NOT EXIST YET. cleancell.clearskyomega.com is NXDOMAIN as of 2026-09-17 — there is no wildcard DNS for *.clearskyomega.com despite what the topology note implies, and budderfly./eastwestenergy./walters. are in the same state. Attach the domain in Vercel before sending anyone at it; until then they sign in on silmarillion.clearskyomega.com, which is an OPEN_HOST in omega-tenant.js and resolves each user's workspace from their email domain rather than redirecting. STILL TO DO on this deal, none of it in this file: the opportunity-input tool, the push through the finance portal submit, and the backfill that makes deliveredToMyOrg() work at all — not one of the 12 fin_profiles carries orgId, so the rule deployed 2026-09-15 is inert for EVERY partner. Amperage needs no provisioning (fin_orgs/amperage-capital exists, tier enterprise); the value their profile is missing is amperagecapital.com, their id in omega_partner_orgs.
